blocks.text: President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. met with Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney on Saturday as Manila and Ottawa inch closer to finalizing their free trade agreement, a deal which is separate from an upcoming tariff-free pact between Canada and the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN).
